**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (¶ p0068–p0069) already delivers our preferred insurance package, binding on Cobalt Cloud Services LLC:

| Playbook requirement | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occ, 2M agg | ✅ USD 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ USD 2,000,000 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (processes Customer Data) | ✅ USD 5,000,000 |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ plus employer's liability USD 1M |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

Additional favorable terms beyond the playbook: a one-year post-term tail, reputable-insurer and primary-coverage requirements, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and express confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (preserving the Section 21.3 Excluded Claims exposure). Given Juniper Ridge's health-data profile, the USD 5M cyber layer sits at our preferred level rather than the fallback, so no escalation is needed.
